correctness.rationale: The graph and finite complexes are defined unambiguously. Exhaustively enumerated face vectors are (12,18,4) and (12,42,48,12). Exact mod-two boundary ranks (11,4) and (11,31,12) saturate rational rank upper bounds, proving rational homology ranks 3 in degree one and 5 in degree two and zero elsewhere. Signed fixed-face traces for all 24 label permutations give Lefschetz arrays (-2,2,2,1,0) and (6,2,2,3,0), and therefore the exact claimed classwise rational homology characters; character inner products yield the stated irreducible modules. Rational orbit-space transfer after barycentric subdivision gives quotient second-Betti ranks 1 and 2. The embedded standalone checker replays every finite step.

value.rationale: The intrinsic S4 action of tetrahedral graph symmetries is a natural equivariant persistence invariant, not implied by previously known nonequivariant homotopy ranks. The scale-two five-dimensional group module contains a sign summand and a standard summand; this yields a precise geometric chirality distinction: the rotational orbit space has two rational second-homology generators but the full reflection-inclusive quotient has one. The exact complete positive-degree S4 persistence is useful for symmetry-aware topology and is a motivated self-contained finite classification.
